purpose: Machine-readable inventory of public count benchmarks, their replicate semantics, reference comparisons and remaining scientific limits.

availableInputs: source-count and quantitative-assay measurements with declared identities
conditional expression-response predictors for selected held-out donors and perturbations
variant-to-regulation hypothesis scores from a verified Atlas capture
missingEvidence: a measured cellular, tissue, disease or treatment endpoint
a model linking the available measurements to that endpoint
independent held-out outcome validation and uncertainty calibration

scope.replicateSemantics: eight biological donors paired across IFNB stimulation and control; sixteen donor-condition pseudobulks

design.comparison: IFNB stimulation versus control in B cells

benchmarks.result: Exact native counts, QC and pseudobulks; native and reference effects are compared descriptively.
limitations: one cell type and one treatment contrast
support rejection and large p-value differences remain
no calibrated significance, causal or production claim
expectedBiology: IFNB stimulation should increase the declared ISG15, IFIT1, IFIT3, MX1 and OAS1 response panel.
Native and reference effects should agree in direction on the predeclared panel under the paired-donor design.

scope.replicateSemantics: single library; donor replication is unavailable

design.holdout: none; interoperability and numerical reconstruction only

benchmarks.result: Full native count/replay route and Scanpy QC agree within the declared numerical tolerance.
limitations: one library with no donor inference
no differential expression or biological outcome endpoint
expectedBiology: Source cell identities, QC totals and sparse count values should survive the AnnData round trip.
No treatment or donor effect is expected because this is a single-library preservation benchmark.

scope.replicateSemantics: annotated tuft cells with two batch labels per treatment; individual donor IDs are not supplied

design.holdout: none; donor differential expression is not admitted

benchmarks.result: Exact native counts/replay and Scanpy QC pass for all annotated tuft cells and source genes.
limitations: individual donors are unavailable
batch labels are not treated as biological replicates
no donor-level DE or outcome claim
expectedBiology: The deposited tuft-cell annotation and integer count axis should survive native import and replay.
No donor-level treatment effect is admitted because individual donors are unavailable.

source.hashScope: six source files; per-file SHA-256 values are retained by audit_hagai_original.py

scope.replicateSemantics: three source mouse prefixes paired across unstimulated and six-hour LPS files; the prefix pairing is explicit inference

design.holdout: none; native NB/PyDESeq2 comparison on three paired donors

benchmarks.result: Exact source counts/QC/pseudobulks and a descriptive paired NB comparison pass the recorded checks.
limitations: pairing is source-name inference, not a direct table crosswalk
two residual degrees of freedom make reference dispersion estimates unreliable
the six-hour contrast is not the paper's four-hour DE reproduction
expectedBiology: LPS6 should increase the predeclared Nfkb2, Nfkbia, Cxcl10, Isg15 and Tnf response panel.
The paired-donor comparison should preserve the source six-hour treatment direction without being called a four-hour paper reproduction.

scope.replicateSemantics: four Vehicle and four LPS independent mice; seven populations publish, CPE remains replication-insufficient

design.holdout: none; direct native versus edgeR/limma-voom/DESeq2 comparison

benchmarks.result: Complete count/QC checks and seven native analyses plus 42 direct R fits pass; strict conditional-refit failures remain retained.
limitations: significance disagreements remain substantial
strict p-value refit checks fail for eight cases
no FDR calibration or biological truth claim
expectedBiology: LPS should produce positive effects for the predeclared Stat1, Irf7, Isg15, B2m and H2-D1 panel where support is available.
The CPE population should remain unavailable when its animal replication gate is insufficient.

source.hashScope: prepared complete-source H5AD; original 131 H5 files retain per-file hashes in the evidence

scope.replicateSemantics: all 131 deposited libraries across five original donors; donor-held-out folds are frozen separately

design.comparison: complete-source ingestion, DE, PCA/graph, integration and conditional response prediction
design.holdout: 79 donor-held-out expression folds; no phenotype or tissue endpoint

benchmarks.result: Complete native ingestion/QC, DE, PCA, graph and frozen expression-fold replay are independently checked.
limitations: biological preservation and rare-cell retention remain unqualified
conditional expression prediction does not establish tissue or treatment outcome prediction
full million-cell clustering/integration performance and GPU qualification remain open
expectedBiology: Donor-held-out expression response should be scored against no-change and training-mean baselines.
Donor and cell-state programs should be retained through integration; failed rare-cell preservation comparisons remain evidence against promotion.

scope.replicateSemantics: technical lane-derived libraries from UHRR/HBRR reference materials; not biological donors

design.comparison: native NB effects versus edgeR, limma-voom and DESeq2 with TaqMan reference

benchmarks.result: All six sites pass the preregistered descriptive measurement gate across the compared methods.
limitations: technical preparations are not biological replication
no intervention, phenotype, clinical benefit or general outcome endpoint
FDR and interval calibration remain open
expectedBiology: Native and reference methods should agree directionally with the independent TaqMan measurement on the declared technical materials.
Technical lane-derived libraries must remain technical measurements rather than biological donor outcomes.
